reporting-org.narrative: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development

description.narrative: A loan of up to EUR 125m or its equivalent in RON in favour of Delgaz Grid SA ("Delgaz", or the "Borrower"), a corporation registered in Romania. Delgaz, a distribution network operator ("DSO") of electricity and gas in the Northern half of Romania, is majority owned by E.ON SE, the German based multinational energy utilities group, with a minority stake owned by Allianz Infrastructure Luxembourg I S.A R.L, and Allianz-Tiriac Asigurari S.A, and Romanian Ministry of Energy. The loan will finance part of the Borrower's capital expenditures programme for its electricity distribution network for the period 2023-2025, aiming at modernisation and upgrades to the electricity grid.
